description: Repo for AI Agents The Definitive Guide
summary: This is the O'Reilly companion code for an agents book, laid out as per-chapter Colab notebooks that walk through CoT, ReAct, hierarchical teams, AB-MCTS, and then the parts most tutorials skip: production contracts, tool governance, evaluation harnesses, and cost-aware design. I starred it because the evaluation and cost chapters (8–9 and 11) are exactly the observability and budgeting groundwork I need when I'm routing parallel agent sessions in PenguPool and driving them remotely through AgentOn Pocket. It's not a framework, just a structured set of runnable notebooks that makes the architecture-to-production pipeline concrete enough to reference while building.
